WITH s AS (
  SELECT ms.product_id,
         p.name AS product_name,
         ms.mth,
         CAST(ms.qty AS REAL) AS qty,
         (CAST(strftime('%Y', ms.mth) AS INTEGER) - 2016) * 12
           + CAST(strftime('%m', ms.mth) AS INTEGER) AS t
  FROM monthly_sales ms
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = ms.product_id
  WHERE ms.mth >= '2016-01-01'
),
cma_calc AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         product_name,
         mth,
         t,
         qty,
         ( AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY t
                          ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING)
         + AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY t
                          ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) ) / 2.0 AS cma
  FROM s
),
ratio_calc AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         product_name,
         mth,
         qty / cma AS sales_to_cma_ratio
  FROM cma_calc
  WHERE t BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND cma IS NOT NULL
    AND cma > 0
)
SELECT product_id,
       product_name
FROM ratio_calc
WHERE strftime('%Y', mth) = '2017'
GROUP BY product_id, product_name
HAVING COUNT(*) = 12
   AND MIN(sales_to_cma_ratio) > 2
ORDER BY product_id

WITH order_pay AS (
  SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_payment
  FROM order_payments
  GROUP BY order_id
),
cust_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id AS cuid,
         o.order_id AS oid,
         date(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_date,
         COALESCE(op.order_payment, 0) AS order_payment
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN order_pay op ON op.order_id = o.order_id
),
cust_agg AS (
  SELECT cuid,
         COUNT(DISTINCT oid) AS number_of_orders,
         CAST(SUM(order_payment) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT oid) AS average_payment_per_order,
         MIN(purchase_date) AS first_purchase_date,
         MAX(purchase_date) AS last_purchase_date
  FROM cust_orders
  GROUP BY cuid
)
SELECT cuid AS customer_unique_id,
       number_of_orders,
       average_payment_per_order,
       CASE WHEN (julianday(last_purchase_date) - julianday(first_purchase_date)) < 7 THEN 1.0
            ELSE (julianday(last_purchase_date) - julianday(first_purchase_date)) / 7.0
       END AS customer_lifespan_weeks
FROM cust_agg
ORDER BY average_payment_per_order DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH career_games AS (
  SELECT a.player_id AS player_id, SUM(CAST(a.g_all AS INTEGER)) AS score_value
  FROM appearances AS a
  WHERE a.player_id IS NOT NULL AND a.g_all IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.player_id
),
career_batting AS (
  SELECT b.player_id AS player_id,
         SUM(CAST(b.r AS INTEGER)) AS runs_value,
         SUM(CAST(b.h AS INTEGER)) AS hits_value,
         SUM(CAST(b.hr AS INTEGER)) AS hr_value
  FROM batting AS b
  WHERE b.player_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY b.player_id
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 'games played' AS statistic, player_id, score_value FROM career_games
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'runs' AS statistic, player_id, runs_value AS score_value FROM career_batting
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'hits' AS statistic, player_id, hits_value AS score_value FROM career_batting
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'home runs' AS statistic, player_id, hr_value AS score_value FROM career_batting
),
mx AS (
  SELECT statistic, MAX(score_value) AS max_value
  FROM stats
  WHERE score_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY statistic
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.statistic AS statistic,
       p.name_given AS name_given,
       s.score_value AS score_value
FROM stats AS s
JOIN mx AS m ON m.statistic = s.statistic AND s.score_value = m.max_value
JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = s.player_id
ORDER BY CASE s.statistic WHEN 'games played' THEN 1 WHEN 'runs' THEN 2 WHEN 'hits' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, s.score_value DESC

WITH party_helmet AS (
  SELECT case_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%'
                    OR party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%motorcycle helmet used%'
                  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS helmet_worn
  FROM parties
  GROUP BY case_id
)
SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(ph.helmet_worn, 0) = 1 THEN 'helmet worn' ELSE 'helmet not worn' END AS helmet_usage,
       ROUND(CAST(SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.case_id), 2) AS fatality_rate_pct
FROM collisions c
LEFT JOIN party_helmet ph ON ph.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(ph.helmet_worn, 0) = 1 THEN 'helmet worn' ELSE 'helmet not worn' END
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(ph.helmet_worn, 0) = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END

SELECT w.name AS winner_name, l.name AS loser_name
FROM Matches m
JOIN Cards c ON m.card_id = c.id
JOIN Promotions p ON c.promotion_id = p.id
JOIN Wrestlers w ON CAST(m.winner_id AS INTEGER) = w.id
JOIN Wrestlers l ON CAST(m.loser_id AS INTEGER) = l.id
WHERE p.name = 'NXT'
  AND m.title_id IS NOT NULL AND m.title_id <> ''
  AND m.title_change = 0
  AND m.duration IS NOT NULL AND m.duration <> '' AND m.duration LIKE '%:%'
ORDER BY CAST(substr(m.duration, 1, instr(m.duration, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(substr(m.duration, instr(m.duration, ':') + 1) AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH delivered_items AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, oi.order_id, oi.price, oi.freight_value
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
delivered_customers AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id, c.customer_unique_id
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist_customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
delivered_five_star_reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, r.review_id
  FROM olist_order_items oi
  JOIN olist_orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN olist_order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND r.review_score = 5
),
customer_rank AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS metric_value,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM delivered_customers
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
profit_rank AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(price, 0) - COALESCE(freight_value, 0)), 2) AS metric_value,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(price, 0) - COALESCE(freight_value, 0)) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM delivered_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
orders_rank AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS metric_value,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM delivered_items
  GROUP BY seller_id
),
reviews_rank AS (
  SELECT seller_id,
         COUNT(review_id) AS metric_value,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(review_id) DESC) AS rnk
  FROM delivered_five_star_reviews
  GROUP BY seller_id
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS sort_order,
         'Seller with the highest number of distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
         seller_id,
         metric_value AS value
  FROM customer_rank WHERE rnk = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2,
         'Seller with the highest profit (price minus freight value)',
         seller_id,
         metric_value
  FROM profit_rank WHERE rnk = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 3,
         'Seller with the highest number of distinct orders',
         seller_id,
         metric_value
  FROM orders_rank WHERE rnk = 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 4,
         'Seller with the most 5-star ratings',
         seller_id,
         metric_value
  FROM reviews_rank WHERE rnk = 1
)
ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT c.name AS category_name,
       SUM((julianday(r.return_date) - julianday(r.rental_date)) * 24) AS total_rental_hours
FROM rental r
JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
JOIN film_category fc ON fc.film_id = i.film_id
JOIN category c ON c.category_id = fc.category_id
JOIN customer cu ON cu.customer_id = r.customer_id
JOIN address a ON a.address_id = cu.address_id
JOIN city ct ON ct.city_id = a.city_id
WHERE ct.city LIKE 'A%' OR ct.city LIKE '%-%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY total_rental_hours DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH line_items AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId AS ArtistId,
         ar.Name AS ArtistName,
         i.CustomerId AS CustomerId,
         ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity AS amount
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN invoices i ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums al ON al.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId
),
customer_artist_spend AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, CustomerId, SUM(amount) AS spent
  FROM line_items
  GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName, CustomerId
),
artist_sales AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName, SUM(spent) AS total_sales
  FROM customer_artist_spend
  GROUP BY ArtistId, ArtistName
),
top_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName
  FROM artist_sales
  ORDER BY total_sales DESC, ArtistName ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId, ArtistName
  FROM artist_sales
  ORDER BY total_sales ASC, ArtistName ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
avgs AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT ArtistName FROM top_artist) AS top_selling_artist,
    (SELECT ArtistName FROM bottom_artist) AS lowest_selling_artist,
    (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM customer_artist_spend
      WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)) AS avg_spend_top_artist_customers,
    (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM customer_artist_spend
      WHERE ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)) AS avg_spend_lowest_artist_customers
)
SELECT top_selling_artist,
       lowest_selling_artist,
       avg_spend_top_artist_customers,
       avg_spend_lowest_artist_customers,
       ABS(avg_spend_top_artist_customers - avg_spend_lowest_artist_customers) AS abs_difference_of_averages
FROM avgs

WITH customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM customer_transactions
),
months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
),
grid AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, m.txn_month
  FROM customers c
  CROSS JOIN months m
),
net AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS txn_month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
filled AS (
  SELECT g.customer_id,
         g.txn_month,
         COALESCE(n.balance, 0) AS balance
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN net n
    ON n.customer_id = g.customer_id
   AND n.txn_month = g.txn_month
),
stats AS (
  SELECT txn_month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customers,
         AVG(CAST(balance AS REAL)) AS avg_balance
  FROM filled
  GROUP BY txn_month
)
SELECT h.txn_month AS highest_month,
       l.txn_month AS lowest_month,
       h.avg_balance AS highest_month_avg_balance,
       l.avg_balance AS lowest_month_avg_balance,
       h.avg_balance - l.avg_balance AS avg_balance_difference
FROM (SELECT txn_month, positive_customers, avg_balance
      FROM stats
      ORDER BY positive_customers DESC, txn_month ASC
      LIMIT 1) h
CROSS JOIN (SELECT txn_month, positive_customers, avg_balance
      FROM stats
      ORDER BY positive_customers ASC, txn_month ASC
      LIMIT 1) l

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT c.customerid,
         SUM(od.unitprice * od.quantity) AS totalamount
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
  JOIN order_details od ON od.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE o.orderdate >= '1998-01-01' AND o.orderdate < '1999-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customerid
)
SELECT g.groupname,
       COUNT(DISTINCT t.customerid) AS numberofcustomers,
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT t.customerid) AS REAL) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM totals) AS percentage
FROM customergroupthreshold g
LEFT JOIN totals t
  ON t.totalamount >= g.rangebottom
 AND t.totalamount <= g.rangetop
GROUP BY g.groupname

WITH rep_sales AS (
  SELECT r.id AS region_id,
         r.name AS region_name,
         sr.id AS rep_id,
         sr.name AS rep_name,
         COUNT(o.id) AS orders_cnt,
         SUM(o.total_amt_usd) AS rep_sales
  FROM web_region r
  JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON sr.region_id = r.id
  JOIN web_accounts a ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
  JOIN web_orders o ON o.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY r.id, r.name, sr.id, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
  SELECT region_id,
         region_name,
         SUM(orders_cnt) AS total_orders,
         SUM(rep_sales) AS total_sales,
         MAX(rep_sales) AS max_rep_sales
  FROM rep_sales
  GROUP BY region_id, region_name
)
SELECT rt.region_name AS region,
       rt.total_orders AS num_orders,
       rt.total_sales AS total_sales_amount,
       rs.rep_name AS top_sales_rep_name,
       rs.rep_sales AS top_sales_rep_amount
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rs.region_id = rt.region_id AND rs.rep_sales = rt.max_rep_sales
ORDER BY rt.region_name, rs.rep_name

WITH sales AS (
  SELECT salespersonid,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         SUM(totaldue) AS total_sales
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY salespersonid, CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER)
),
quota AS (
  SELECT BusinessEntityID,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         SUM(SalesQuota) AS annual_quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER)
)
SELECT s.salespersonid,
       s.yr AS year,
       ROUND(s.total_sales, 2) AS total_sales,
       q.annual_quota,
       ROUND(s.total_sales - q.annual_quota, 2) AS sales_minus_quota
FROM sales s
JOIN quota q
  ON q.BusinessEntityID = s.salespersonid
 AND q.yr = s.yr
ORDER BY s.salespersonid, s.yr

WITH director_movies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.name_id, dm.movie_id
  FROM director_mapping dm
),
base AS (
  SELECT dmd.name_id,
         m.id AS movie_id,
         m.date_published,
         m.duration,
         r.avg_rating,
         r.total_votes
  FROM director_movies dmd
  JOIN movies m ON m.id = dmd.movie_id
  LEFT JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = m.id
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT name_id,
         julianday(date_published) - julianday(LAG(date_published) OVER (PARTITION BY name_id ORDER BY date_published, movie_id)) AS gap_days
  FROM base
),
gap_avg AS (
  SELECT name_id, AVG(gap_days) AS avg_gap_days
  FROM gaps
  WHERE gap_days IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY name_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT name_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) AS movie_count,
         ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         SUM(COALESCE(total_votes, 0)) AS total_votes,
         MIN(avg_rating) AS min_rating,
         MAX(avg_rating) AS max_rating,
         SUM(duration) AS total_movie_duration
  FROM base
  GROUP BY name_id
)
SELECT a.name_id AS id,
       n.name AS name,
       a.movie_count,
       CAST(ROUND(g.avg_gap_days) AS INTEGER) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
       a.avg_rating,
       a.total_votes,
       a.min_rating,
       a.max_rating,
       a.total_movie_duration
FROM agg a
JOIN names n ON n.id = a.name_id
LEFT JOIN gap_avg g ON g.name_id = a.name_id
ORDER BY a.movie_count DESC, a.total_movie_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', term_start) AS INTEGER) AS start_year
  FROM legislators_terms
  WHERE term_number = 0
    AND term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
),
years(n) AS (
  SELECT 1
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM years WHERE n < 20
),
retained AS (
  SELECT y.n AS year_number,
         COUNT(DISTINCT c.id_bioguide) AS retained_legislators
  FROM years y
  JOIN cohort c
  JOIN legislators_terms t
    ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
   AND t.term_start <= (c.start_year + y.n - 1) || '-12-31'
   AND COALESCE(NULLIF(t.term_end, ''), '9999-12-31') >= (c.start_year + y.n - 1) || '-12-31'
  GROUP BY y.n
)
SELECT y.n AS year_number,
       CAST(COALESCE(r.retained_legislators, 0) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort) AS retention_rate
FROM years y
LEFT JOIN retained r ON r.year_number = y.n
ORDER BY y.n

WITH film_revenue AS (
  SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue
  FROM payment p
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  GROUP BY i.film_id
),
cast_size AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_id) AS n_actors
  FROM film_actor
  GROUP BY film_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT a.actor_id,
         a.first_name,
         a.last_name,
         f.title,
         ROUND(fr.total_revenue, 2) AS film_revenue,
         ROUND(CAST(fr.total_revenue AS REAL) / NULLIF(cs.n_actors, 0), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY a.actor_id
           ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC, f.title ASC, f.film_id ASC
         ) AS revenue_rank
  FROM actor a
  JOIN film_actor fa ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id
  JOIN film_revenue fr ON fr.film_id = fa.film_id
  JOIN cast_size cs ON cs.film_id = fa.film_id
)
SELECT actor_id,
       first_name,
       last_name,
       title,
       film_revenue,
       avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank <= 3
ORDER BY actor_id, film_revenue DESC, title

WITH RECURSIVE up(c) AS (SELECT 65 UNION ALL SELECT c + 1 FROM up WHERE c < 90), lo(c) AS (SELECT 97 UNION ALL SELECT c + 1 FROM lo WHERE c < 122), letters(l) AS (SELECT char(c) FROM up UNION ALL SELECT char(c) FROM lo), src AS (SELECT DISTINCT words AS w FROM word_list WHERE length(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5), cnts AS (SELECT s.w AS w, lt.l AS l, length(s.w) - length(replace(s.w, lt.l, '')) AS k FROM src s CROSS JOIN letters lt), sig AS (SELECT w, length(w) || '#' || group_concat(k, ',') AS signature FROM (SELECT w, l, k FROM cnts ORDER BY w, l) GROUP BY w), grp AS (SELECT signature, COUNT(*) AS group_size FROM sig GROUP BY signature) SELECT s.w AS word, g.group_size - 1 AS anagram_count FROM sig s JOIN grp g ON g.signature = s.signature WHERE substr(s.w, 1, 1) = 'r' AND g.group_size > 1 ORDER BY s.w LIMIT 10

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT s.hub_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_finished,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_finished
  FROM orders o
  JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
    AND o.order_created_year = 2021
    AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
  GROUP BY s.hub_id
)
SELECT h.hub_id,
       h.hub_name,
       h.hub_city,
       h.hub_state,
       m.feb_finished,
       m.mar_finished,
       ROUND((CAST(m.mar_finished - m.feb_finished AS REAL) / m.feb_finished) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM monthly m
JOIN hubs h ON h.hub_id = m.hub_id
WHERE m.feb_finished > 0
  AND CAST(m.mar_finished - m.feb_finished AS REAL) / m.feb_finished > 0.2
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

WITH match_points AS (
  SELECT m.season,
         m.country_id,
         m.league_id,
         m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
              WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS pts
  FROM Match m
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.season,
         m.country_id,
         m.league_id,
         m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
         CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
              WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
              ELSE 0 END AS pts
  FROM Match m
),
standings AS (
  SELECT mp.season,
         c.name AS country_name,
         l.name AS league_name,
         t.team_long_name AS team_name,
         SUM(mp.pts) AS total_points,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY mp.season, mp.country_id, mp.league_id
                            ORDER BY SUM(mp.pts) DESC, t.team_long_name) AS rnk
  FROM match_points mp
  JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = mp.team_api_id
  JOIN League l ON l.id = mp.league_id
  JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
  GROUP BY mp.season, mp.country_id, mp.league_id, c.name, l.name, t.team_long_name
)
SELECT season,
       team_name,
       league_name,
       country_name,
       total_points
FROM standings
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY season, country_name, league_name

WITH seller_items AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS items_sold,
         ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS total_sales,
         ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_item_price
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
  HAVING COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 100
),
seller_reviews AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         ROUND(AVG(r.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_packing AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         ROUND(AVG(julianday(oi.shipping_limit_date) - julianday(o.order_purchase_timestamp)), 2) AS avg_packing_time_days
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id
),
seller_categories AS (
  SELECT oi.seller_id,
         COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_english,
         COUNT(*) AS category_qty,
         SUM(oi.price) AS category_sales
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  GROUP BY oi.seller_id, category_english
)
SELECT si.seller_id,
       si.items_sold,
       si.total_sales,
       si.avg_item_price,
       sr.avg_review_score,
       sp.avg_packing_time_days,
       (SELECT sc.category_english
        FROM seller_categories sc
        WHERE sc.seller_id = si.seller_id
        ORDER BY sc.category_qty DESC, sc.category_sales DESC
        LIMIT 1) AS top_category_english
FROM seller_items si
LEFT JOIN seller_reviews sr ON sr.seller_id = si.seller_id
LEFT JOIN seller_packing sp ON sp.seller_id = si.seller_id
ORDER BY si.total_sales DESC

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session
),
norm AS (
  SELECT a.session,
         a.stamp,
         b.first_stamp,
         b.last_stamp,
         CASE
           WHEN a.path IS NULL OR TRIM(a.path) = '' THEN '/'
           WHEN a.path LIKE '%/' THEN SUBSTR(a.path, 1, LENGTH(a.path) - 1)
           ELSE a.path
         END AS path
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN bounds b ON b.session = a.session
),
landing AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT path, session FROM norm WHERE stamp = first_stamp
),
exiting AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT path, session FROM norm WHERE stamp = last_stamp
),
combined AS (
  SELECT path, session FROM landing
  UNION
  SELECT path, session FROM exiting
)
SELECT path,
       COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS total_sessions
FROM combined
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC, path ASC

WITH season_rounds AS (
  SELECT res.driver_id, ra.year, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.round) AS rounds_raced
  FROM results res
  JOIN races ra ON ra.race_id = res.race_id
  WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  GROUP BY res.driver_id, ra.year
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ra.round) >= 2
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.driver_id, d.forename, d.surname
FROM drives f
JOIN drives l
  ON l.driver_id = f.driver_id
 AND l.year = f.year
 AND l.constructor_id = f.constructor_id
JOIN season_rounds sr
  ON sr.driver_id = f.driver_id
 AND sr.year = f.year
JOIN drivers d
  ON d.driver_id = f.driver_id
WHERE f.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 1959
  AND f.is_first_drive_of_season = 1
  AND l.is_final_drive_of_season = 1
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename
